events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Chrissie Hynde's 75th birthday! Her distinctive voice and rebellious spirit have defined The Pretenders for decades. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his attitude and voice are unmistakable. What's your top Liam track?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, 007 has it all. What's your favourite Bond film or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Which Lennon song means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: A True Champion
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice, showmanship, and music continue to electrify. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Masterpiece Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound and songwriting. Which track is your favourite?
